per_change.reason: Habitual action in childhood framed by 'cuando éramos niñas, siempre' requires imperfect.
Repeated/habitual looking parallel to 'paraban' and 'entendían'; preterite breaks the habitual frame.
Describes what a program offered (background description), so imperfect 'era'.
Reason/background for sleeping on the floor ('it was easier') is descriptive: 'era más fácil'.
Duration of a past stay takes por/durante (or nothing), not para.
Age at the time of an event is always imperfect: 'cuando tenía 28 años'.
Background reason (he had work there) is a state: 'porque tenía trabajo'.
Physical state parallel to 'estaba muy mojada' is background: 'tenía frío'.
Starting the hike is a single foregrounded event in the narrative: 'empezamos'.
Identity/state discovered (that the animals were aliens) takes imperfect: 'eran'.
'Actividades por hacer' (things still to be done) is idiomatic and natural.
A dated, completed event (emergency surgery in May 2000) needs preterite.
Revealing what an object was (identity/description) takes imperfect: 'la pistola era un juguete'.
'Importante para la cultura' (important to/for); 'por' gives a strained 'because of' reading.
Summative evaluation of a bounded period ('los días en el hospital fueron aburridos') is natural preterite.
Recipient/beneficiary of something made: 'para su madre'.
Reason expressed as an ongoing state: 'porque tenía hambre'.
'Tenían planes vagos por unos años' reads naturally as duration (por = durante); para is not required.
Not knowing the difference is a state; 'supe' means 'found out'.
'Famoso por' (famous for/because of) is fixed; para is wrong.
'Regalo para nuestro aniversario' (gift for the occasion) is natural; por is an alternative.
Purpose/goal of studying: 'estudiar para mis clases'.
'Hasta que se sentía enferma todo el tiempo' describes the resulting ongoing state; imperfect is natural with 'todo el tiempo'.
Imperfect can present the questioning as ongoing/simultaneous with the police going after the men; natural narrative backgrounding.
'Mi cosa favorita del fin de semana era mi perrito' is a descriptive statement; both era and fue are used.
Bounded total duration ('no ... por solo algunas semanas') of a completed stay requires preterite.
'Por sí misma' (on her own) is grammatical but intended meaning (for herself) is uncertain from garbled text.
Giving birth is a completed event: 'recién tuvo un bebé'.
'Jugar por el equipo nacional' (represent) is widely used, especially in Latin American sports usage.
'Compré una bicicleta para mi cumpleaños' is natural (occasion/destination).
Deadline/target time: 'para el verano'.
Imperfect sets an ongoing scene (grandma was talking with mom) alongside 'estaban preocupados'.
Scheduled time as background ('aunque su vuelo era muy temprano') takes imperfect.
Recipients of cooking: 'para mi familia'.
Depends on whether it describes him (era) or sums up a closed period (fue); context insufficient.
'Teníamos que subir al metro' (obligation framing the plan) is common native narrative usage.
Reason state parallel to 'no quería': 'porque tenía miedo'.
Habitual frame 'siempre cuando pasaba tiempo' parallel to 'tenía' requires imperfect.
'Famoso por su trabajo'.
Starting out is a single past beginning; 'comenzaba' with no habitual/background reading is wrong (should be comencé).
Duration of stay: 'por/durante una semana', not para.
'Cada actividad que hicimos' over a bounded trip is a natural totalizing preterite.
Exchange/payment: 'pagar por los asientos'.
Opinion about a general state, under 'pensaba': 'pensaba que era raro'.
Realizing a need: the need is a state, 'supe que necesitaba ir'.
Meaning of 'la situación fue muy realístico' is unclear; aspect choice cannot be judged confidently.
'Era por una mejor oportunidad' (motive, in pursuit of) is natural, cf. 'emigrar por una vida mejor'.
'Trabaja mucho por mi familia' (for the sake of) is natural.
Habitual parallel to 'siempre trabajaban duro': 'no ganaban mucho dinero'.
Doing something in memory/for the sake of a deceased person: 'trabajar por él'; 'para él' implies an employer.
'Activista para el movimiento' is unnatural, but 'activista por el movimiento por...' is also awkward ('del movimiento' expected).
'Pensó que sería bueno decirle' = she thought/decided at that moment; natural preterite.
'Un boleto ... para su cumpleaños' (occasion) is natural.
'Me hizo sentir incómoda' (on that occasion) is natural; imperfect is an alternative.
'Amor por los deportes' is required.
Habitual description of the summer ('crecía cada día') calls for 'se sentaban'.
Habitual childhood activity parallel to 'salíamos', 'jugábamos'.
Purpose: 'estudio mucho para la clase'.
'Para siempre' is wrong (future), but 'por siempre' is not the natural fix either ('desde siempre'); both off.
Background state before 'decidió' with 'por mucho tiempo' is commonly imperfect in narrative; preterite also fine.
'No pudo comer nada' (failed to eat on that occasion) is natural.
Reason/desire as state: 'porque quería'; 'quise' = tried/decided.
'Hacer cambios por los grupos minoritarios' (on behalf of) is acceptable alongside para.
Purpose/destination: 'comida para el viaje'.
Experiencer: 'aterrador para estas personas'.
Destination/purpose: 'las cosas para la casa'.
Habitual self-perception through childhood naturally takes imperfect.
Habitual liking/description: 'le gustaba correr'.
'El mejor hotel para el precio' (considering the price) is acceptable; 'por el precio' also fine.
State of need under 'sabía': 'sabía que necesitaba'.
Exchange: 'vender por dinero'.
'Cuando estaba allí' as background frame is natural.
'Era un sentimiento increíble' (description of the feeling) is natural; fue also fine.
Identity revealed in 'descubrieron que...' takes imperfect: 'ella era la princesa'.
'Cada miércoles' habitual: 'ocurría'.
Purpose: 'estudiar para las clases'.
Repeated: 'en todos los lugares adonde iban' -> 'encontraban'.
'Como siempre' habitual state: 'estaba solo'.
'Quiso no hacer caso' = tried to ignore it (attempt), natural preterite meaning.
'Jugaba por (la selección de) Estados Unidos' (representing) is natural.
'Fue mi programa favorito' as a bounded past period is natural.
'Luchar por + infinitivo' is the standard construction.
'Empecé a ver que era tan especial': perceived characteristics are imperfect.
'Era muy inteligente': characteristic description.
Unbounded emotional state as background to 'decidió': 'estaba apenada'.
'Funeral por mi abuelo' is natural (cf. 'misa por').
Identifying what was seen ('fueron lo que vi') aligns with preterite 'vi'.
Ongoing action interrupted ('gritaban hasta que la madre entró') is natural.
Relative to an occasion/purpose: 'tarde para su primer día'.
Description and reason under 'me dijo que': 'su pelo era corto porque era fácil'.
Single arrival event in narrative: 'cuando llegué'.
Content of a letter is described with imperfect: 'una carta que decía'.
